route_review.product_step: requirements -> sizing -> comparison and scheme cards
route_review.next_gate: V0.2.0 workflow acceptance, bounded fuel model review and professional review

diagnostics: 同航段航程/航时要求需低于当前允许最小平飞速度；不能自动追加留空

reference.configuration: wheel fairings installed, economy mixture leaned to peak EGT, still air
reference.interpretation: speed uses chart gross weight 2550 lb; fuel is the same 65% rated-power example; whole flight-plan 2400 lb not compared
reference.data_role: independent handbook spot check; not calibration and not new flight-test data

assumptions.source: WingDesignHub V0.1.7 独立金属单发概念模板；系数为待校准工程假设，非真实型号数据

limits: 匹配压力高度、实际温度、巡航图重量、功率与参考面积；极曲线和桨效率仍为平台默认假设。
单个手册工况仅测量模型偏差，不构成整机、全包线或完整任务精度验收。
同一额定功率下的经济混合比耗油可暴露常数 BSFC 的局限；保持偏差，不据此自动改默认值。
主总体任务仍采用标准大气；此处显式密度仅用于同条件对照，不代表高温高原整机能力已接通。

ui_verification.confirmation_origin: synthetic UI validation, not user design approval
